crew.overview: The chronicles of four years in the life of Julie, a young woman who navigates the troubled waters of her love life and struggles to find her career path, leading her to take a realistic look at who she really is.
crew.title: The Worst Person in the World

details.biography: Mats Lid Støten is a Norwegian sound designer. During his studies at NISS, Mats jumped straight into the film industry. After doing the production sound on the feature film, 'Det som en gang var', he has never looked back. Attention to detail, hard work and passion for storytelling through sound is what puts a smile on his face.
details.name: Mats Lid Støten
